      Texas Home Builder Ranked Among Nation's Best

      June 10, 2024

      McAllen, TX. Texas based builder, Esperanza Homes, is excited to announce their placement 2024 BUILDER 100 List. This is the first year Esperanza Homes has been ranked on this prestigious BUILDER 100 List after its continued rise in the BUILDER 100 and NEXT 100 rankings each year from 2020. This means we rank among the top 100 home builders in the country. The ranking is based upon US builders’ home closings from the previous year. In 2024, Esperanza homes secured the 99th spot with 505 closings.


      BUILDER 100 Days of Celebration

      To celebrate this milestone, Esperanza Homes will be offering special incentives during our “BUILDER100 Days of Celebration” from June 8, 2024, to Sep 16, 2024.

      The Future for Esperanza Homes

      With over forty floor plans, Esperanza Homes offers homeowners homes and communities that bring comfort, sustainability and affordability. This year, Esperanza Homes is excited to offer new floor plans based upon feedback from customers. This is in addition to the over forty floor plans offered by Esperanza Homes. The goal is to offer homes that are on trend, offer unique options and great personalization for Rio Grande Valley homebuyers.

      Looking towards the future, there are numerous new planned developments and master planned communities for Esperanza Homes. In May, the groundbreaking ceremony took place for the new Stewart Coves community in San Juan, and construction began on Phase II of Rogers Coves in Edinburg. This is just the beginning of plans to meet South Texas’ housing needs.

      With thirty years of land development and building within the Rio Grande Valley, Rhodes and Esperanza Homes are excited to continue building upon their success and delivering exceptional homes to their customers. This recognition reflects the company’s commitment to enhancing lives and building communities. For more information on Esperanza Homes, promotions, and our latest communities follow us on Facebook and Instagram.
